findingClass: a DOC-ranked ipo_field_plan row answers rank1:DOC:NOT_AVAILABLE_YET ('no document yet') although its IPO already holds a COMPLETED offer document — the DOC fetcher's documentType family was narrower than spec §1's 'best available type' (PRICE_BAND_AD family = PRICE_BAND_AD only), so every IPO without a price-band ad (all SME) waited forever. F-161: 984 staging rows on 23 IPOs, 2026-09-24
whatItAsks: no plan row with rank1_source = DOC has a cause starting rank1:DOC:NOT_AVAILABLE_YET whose last_attempt_at is later than the extracted_at of a COMPLETED, active RHP / DRHP / PROSPECTUS / PRICE_BAND_AD of the same IPO
alarmsWhen: any non-zero; one notify per IPO (top 8) naming the fields
scope: every IPO, every status and segment, prod + staging slots; keyed on the recorded rank-1 cause, not the state, so a row a lower rank supplied provisionally still counts
consumerReason: a structural fact about the DOC fetcher's document matching, read by IPO identity each run; it goes GONE only after the fixed fetcher re-walks the rows
sourceDesign: docs/design/data-sourcing-pull-model.md §1 (DOC = best available type; document type order), §2.4
